interface.signature: maxScoreWords(words: List[str], letters: List[str], score: List[int]) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of words is between 1 and 14.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(word) <= 15 for word in words)
preconditions.description: Each word has a length between 1 and 15.
The number of letters is between 1 and 100.
Each letter is a single character.
The score list has exactly 26 elements.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= s <= 10 for s in score)

preconditions.description: All words contain only lowercase English letters.
All letters are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(sum(score[ord(c) - ord('a')] for c in word) for word in selected_words)
postconditions.description: The maximum score is the sum of scores of the selected words.
